text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: CONGESTIVE HEART FAILURE (ACUTE DECOMPENSATION)

The symptoms of bilateral lower leg swelling, significant weight loss, and fatigue in a 66-year-old male with a history of chronic lung disease strongly suggest acute decompensated heart failure. I need to confirm if you are experiencing shortness of breath, especially when lying flat, and if you have noticed a decrease in your urine output or an increase in coughing up frothy fluid. REQUEST TEST: BNP, Troponin, CBC, CMP, Chest_X-Ray.
